title: China signs the Boxer Protocol
summary: The Qing government signed the Boxer Protocol with eleven foreign powers in Beijing, agreeing to pay a huge indemnity, execute officials and allow foreign troops to be stationed in the capital.
reason: The foreign powers that had crushed the Boxer Rebellion imposed punishment and guarantees after occupying Beijing.
significance: It deepened China's humiliation and financial ruin, discrediting the Qing dynasty in the decade before its fall.
